risks.title: Dependence on single suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in the first part of risk factors, with strong language ("material adverse effect"). Dependence on a single supplier for certain products is recurring and critical. The Supply Chain category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Competition in the bioprocessing market
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned among the first factors affecting revenue. The market is described as competitive, with direct impact on market penetration and profitability. Language is assertive but less alarming than for suppliers.

risks.title: Cyberattacks on internal or third-party systems
risks.score_rationale: An existential risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1C Cybersecurity and referenced here. A cyberattack could severely disrupt development programs. The language is alarming and the regulatory context is tense.

risks.title: Supply chain shortages or disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Cited as a negative factor on revenue. The risk is repeated multiple times, with links to geopolitical and health events. Less critical than dependence on a single supplier, but still major.

risks.title: Acquisition-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Multiple acquisitions mentioned (15 since 2012). The text explicitly highlights the risk of failing to realize expected benefits. Language is cautious but recurring, with strong strategic impact.

risks.title: Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as a potential impact on results. Less central than other risks, but present in an international context with global manufacturing sites. Moderate language.

risks.title: Geopolitical events or natural disasters
risks.score_rationale: Cited with concrete examples (Ukraine/Israel wars, pandemics). Strong language on possible impact on supply and demand. Systemic risk, difficult to control, therefore highly severe.

ai_positioning.summary: The company RGEN does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on financial, product, and operational aspects of the company without reference to AI.
